description: Worldwide multi-domain article/event taxonomy. Adds defense_other for evidenced defense developments outside the named event families; v1 remains archived.

guidance.defense: Substantive armed-forces, defense-policy, military procurement, security cooperation, or military-intelligence developments in any country.
guidance.economics: Economic policy, markets, trade, energy, sanctions, production or financial events; details to be expanded later.
guidance.geopolitics: Diplomatic relationships, foreign policy, sovereignty and international institutional developments.
guidance.cybersecurity: Cyberattacks, cyber defense, vulnerability exploitation, and cyber operations.
guidance.other: No substantive event in the monitored intelligence domains.
guidance.multi_label: Use every substantively evidenced domain and defense event type; do not force a single class.
guidance.no_inference: Do not infer an event, country or actor only from a headline, background mention, or embedding similarity. Record uncertainty and source attribution.
guidance.defense_other: Use only for substantive defense developments outside all named categories. Explain the gap; it is not a label for uncertainty or merely military-themed ceremonies.
